bottleneck: Two-part. (1) F3 (f263262, GGUF MMVQ thresholds) remains UNGATED and is structurally un-closable by the frozen formal gate: the gate loads BF16 safetensors rev e6406af83988f26e87ea92455f31db3f6476131b and never passes a GGUF file/--quantization gguf, and every frozen gate point runs at batch >= 32 where both the legacy and shipped thresholds select MMQ, so f263262 is score-neutral by construction and a BF16 delta attributed to it would be noise (controller applicability-001). G3 t2 already shipped the default-OFF dispatch tracer (4e1644a) and the bounded GGUF protocol; the controller has NOT executed it (NOT_TESTED), so no new F3 evidence exists this trial. (2) Full-engine on a4: recon of FlashInferIndicesUpdaterDecode.call_begin_forward (python/sglang/srt/layers/attention/flashinfer_backend.py) found a redundant device->host read on the eager decode path. In the SWA full->swa translate block, kv_indices[:kv_indptr[-1]] uses a 0-dim CUDA tensor as a slice bound; Tensor.__index__ forces .item(), a full stream drain once per eager decode step for every sliding layer. The equal host int is already a parameter of the same function (paged_kernel_lens_sum), and kv_indptr[1:bs+1] is built by cumsum(paged_kernel_lens) from that same tensor at flashinfer_backend.py:1789-1791 in the same call, so the device read is redundant.
hypothesis: H-G3-3: replacing the device slice bound with the equal host int paged_kernel_lens_sum removes one stream drain per eager decode step on SWA layers without changing any index (integer identity => bit-identical kv_indices => EXACT by construction). Effect is conditional and may be zero: (a) the block is entered only when self._swa_kv_pool is not None (resolver returns the pool when the allocator kvcache is a BaseSWAKVPool, likely true here for 21/28 sliding layers) AND not translator.reads_are_translated (false on a non-unified pool per kv_index_translator.py:642-647); (b) begin_forward is not re-called at CUDA-graph replay, so graph-captured decode points cannot benefit and only eager decode can. Magnitude is unmeasured. Sibling glm-a reported a 14.4 ms/step stream sync in this same updater family on a1, but that is cross-node evidence and is NOT transferable; a ~1.0 gate is a valid and expected-possible outcome that would classify the path as dead on a4. No exactness claim beyond integer identity; the gate's exact-token check is the arbiter.
patch: Commit 33e5ac4 on parent b4fc419 (campaign base f263262). One runtime file, +11/-1: python/sglang/srt/layers/attention/flashinfer_backend.py, FlashInferIndicesUpdaterDecode.call_begin_forward. Adds host_indptr_last = paged_kernel_lens_sum only when the call rebuilt kv_indptr from paged_kernel_lens and the caller passed an int (isinstance guard), and uses it as kv_last_index in the SWA translate block; otherwise the original kv_indptr[-1] device read is kept (spec_info.kv_indptr branch, non-int callers). No selection, threshold, kernel, plan-argument or measurement change; no new imports. Also plan.md (trial record). Nothing under seis/ is modified, so the G3 t2 GGUF protocol/artifacts remain at b4fc419.
